profiles.name: best_runtime_latency
profiles.notes: Small 128k-context model from NVIDIA's catalog. Live benchmark from this workspace timed out in both JSON and stream mode on 2026-05-07, so it is not the default.

profiles.name: instant_long_context
profiles.notes: Small current default with 128k context. Good for lowest latency simple chat.

profiles.name: balanced_long_context
profiles.notes: 8B long-context option. Live discovery benchmark across 136 NVIDIA /models entries on this workspace had the fastest useful native stream result: 0.271s first token and 0.320s total.

profiles.name: memory_json_latency
profiles.notes: Fastest useful JSON completion in live discovery benchmark: 0.290s total. Used for background memory extraction through NVIDIA_MEMORY_MODEL.

profiles.name: nemotron_fast_agentic
profiles.notes: Hybrid Transformer-Mamba NVIDIA model aimed at efficient reasoning and agentic tasks.

profiles.name: llama_strong_runtime
profiles.notes: 70B long-context option. Strong model, but the broader live discovery stream benchmark picked the 8B model for lower latency.
